name: a flat front view of a kitchen counter against a cream tiled wall: the counter slab and its drawer fronts bleed past both edges, a tied sack of rice stands cut by the left edge, a rail on the wall holds a ladle, a rice paddle and a towel; the hook is plain saturated orange
fits: cooked food, rice, leftovers, the heat and the cold of food on a counter; the hero is a rice cooker cut open in front view (the shell, the inner bowl with rice, the heating plate, the sensor, the closed lid with its vent); the thermometer and the magnified rice grain with spores are the explainers
recipe: flat 2D front view, no iso: a cream wall, a tile band with grout lines, a PLASTER counter slab on a grey front with two drawer fronts and handles, the cooker standing on the slab; the callout is a rounded card (never a disc) with a rice grain and spore capsules (a dark shell, a light body)
